plan.title: Live event extension and vendor countdown

steps.note: Open the existing live event with an invited vendor.
Expose the published event's available actions.
Record the extension controls for inspection; this does not assert an extension was saved.
Dismiss the inspection dialog without claiming to change the end time.
Check baseline bidding using the configured vendor account, which must already be invited.
Assert the baseline bid landed, not that bidding continued after an extension.
